title: Coils & Nodes
description:
After building Bumper Ball, I used the same framework to make this puzzle game where you have to shuffle boxes around to open a clear path for electricity to connect all the nodes.

![](assets/projects/college/coils-nodes/screenshot-1.webp)

This made use of good old **A\* pathfinding** to connect the nodes dynamically. Creating all the assets was really fun.

![](assets/projects/college/coils-nodes/screenshot-3.webp)

![](assets/projects/college/coils-nodes/screenshot-2.webp)

After the game was finished, I ported the whole thing to Windows Phone using XNA, and added touch controls, so it could be played on mobile too!

![](/assets/projects/college/coils-nodes/screenshot-4.webp)

In 2022, I ported the original project to web with **p5.js** to keep it alive and playable longer.
